title: MobCapture
description: MobCapture is a comprehensive Minecraft plugin for Paper servers that enables players to capture and release mobs within a configurable radius, while featuring a complete economic system with marketplace and banking, plus night vision upgrades.
body:
MobCapture is a comprehensive Minecraft plugin designed for Paper servers that revolutionizes mob interaction and economic gameplay. The plugin allows players to capture and release mobs with configurable limits, while introducing advanced economic systems and quality-of-life features.

Core Features:
Mob Capture System: Capture mobs within a configurable radius and store them with type-specific limits

Mob Release: Safely release stored mobs back into the world

Configurable Limits: Set individual capture limits for each mob type via config.yml

Economic System:
Virtual Economy: Complete money system with balance tracking

Marketplace: GUI-based market to buy/sell items with dynamically configurable prices

Banking System: Full banking functionality with roles (Manager/Customer)

Real-time Reload: Update market prices without server restart using /reload_mercado

Player Enhancements:
Night Vision: Toggleable night vision with upgradeable duration using /luz

Upgrade System: Improve night vision duration using diamonds with /luzupgrade

Angel Chest: Death protection system that saves items in a temporary chest with hologram

Auto-item Recovery: Click chests to instantly recover items after death

Commands:
/capturarmob - Capture mobs in radius (default 4 blocks)

/liberarmob - Release stored mobs

/luz - Toggle night vision (30 seconds base)

/luzupgrade - Upgrade night vision duration with diamonds

/money - Check balance with beautiful UI

/mercado - Open marketplace GUI

/banco - Access banking services

/reload_mercado - Reload market configurations

Technical Features:
UUID-based Storage: Secure player data storage

Config-driven: Fully customizable via config.yml

Hologram Support: Visual indicators for Angel Chests

Role-based Access: Bank manager (PlayerBrasil) and customer roles

Event-driven Architecture: Efficient event handling for optimal performance

The plugin enhances survival gameplay by providing meaningful mob interactions, robust economic systems, and player convenience features while maintaining server balance through configurable limits and prices. Perfect for survival servers looking to add depth to their economic and mob interaction systems.
